# ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry Weekly Report (May 17 - 23, 2026)

## 🚀 Highlights
This week focused on stabilizing the Superchain infrastructure through critical bug fixes and registry maintenance. Significant progress was made in resolving protocol-level discrepancies, notably fixing a Brotli channel divergence between `kona` and `op-node`. The team also advanced Interop readiness by migrating RPC namespaces and refining dispute game testing frameworks. While routine automated maintenance kept the registry synchronized, active development shifted toward preparing devnets for Interop proofs and addressing persistent test flakiness.

## 🛠️ Key Developments
The week’s technical work centered on registry accuracy, protocol synchronization, and CI/CD optimization.

### Registry Maintenance & Chain Updates
*   **Automated Synchronization:** Multiple automated codegen updates were merged to keep `addresses.json` and other registry files in sync with the evolving ecosystem ([#1230](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1230), [#1231](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1231), [#1236](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1236)).
*   **Chain Metadata:** Updates were pushed for Alchemy-supported chains following recent upgrades ([#1235](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1235)) and specific timestamps (Isthmus and Jovian) were added for Settlus-Sepolia and Settlus-Mainnet ([#1234](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1234)).

### Protocol & Infrastructure Refinement
*   **Brotli Channel Divergence:** Resolved a critical disagreement between `kona` and `op-node` regarding Brotli channels, addressing both internal wrapper bugs and upstream crate issues ([#19333](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/19333)).
*   **RPC & Namespace Migration:** Completed the transition of the supervisor RPC namespace to a dedicated interop filter namespace, streamlining how interop-related queries are handled ([#20005](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20005)).
*   **CI/CD Streamlining:** Initiated a migration to `circleci-repo-rpc-secrets` and dropped the `circleci_ip_ranges` flag to improve the security and efficiency of the CI pipeline ([#1233](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1233)).
*   **Proof Parameters:** Opened updates for standard proof-game timing parameters to ensure consistency across the Superchain ([#1232](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1232)).

## 🐛 Issues & Triage
The project saw a high volume of issue resolution alongside the identification of complex race conditions in the testing suite.

### Closed Issues
*   **Testing & Documentation:** The migration of dispute game tests from `op-e2e` to `op-acceptance-tests` was finalized ([#20814](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20814)). Documentation regarding interop tx pool eviction was closed as the behavior is now natively handled in `op-reth` ([#19351](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/19351)).
*   **Feature Validation:** An investigation into `debug_executePayload` concluded that the code is essential for fault-proof witness prefetching and will remain in the codebase ([#20879](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20879)).

### New & Active Issues
*   **Flaky Test Investigation:** Significant effort is being directed at `TestChallengerCountersPreGenesisGame` ([#20869](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20869)), where a race condition between L1 block mining and migration was identified. A fix involving a post-migration L1-head re-read is in progress.
*   **Devnet Blockers:** The integration of SDM with flashblocks is currently blocked pending upstream progress in the Optimism repository ([#20175](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20175)).
*   **Interop Proofs Devnet:** Discussions are ongoing regarding the deployment of a long-term internal testing environment using `SuperRootMigrations` and `InteropPortal` feature flags ([#20489](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20489)).

## 💬 Community & Collaboration
Collaboration this week was characterized by deep technical troubleshooting between maintainers. Notable interactions included `maurelian` providing a detailed root-cause analysis for migration-related test failures and `jelias2` coordinating the transition of test networks into long-term internal infrastructure. The team also demonstrated active "housekeeping" by identifying and closing duplicate issues related to the `OPContractsManagerMigrator` and outdated documentation, ensuring the contributor focus remains on high-priority Interop and security milestones.
